## Abstract

The Security Architecture domain encompasses decisions related to authentication frameworks, authorization strategies, encryption standards, security compliance requirements, and threat protection measures. This domain ensures comprehensive security coverage across all enterprise systems, applications, and data assets.

Security architecture decisions directly impact risk posture, compliance status, data protection effectiveness, and overall enterprise security resilience.
